description: NaTh₂F₉ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅42m space group. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are two shorter (2.28 Å) and four longer (2.46 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Th is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Th-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.47 Å. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Th atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Th atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na and two equivalent Th atoms. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Th atoms.
